tgm50-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tgm50-wifi-ep.description: Wi-Fi touchscreen room thermostat from the TGM50 series, suitable for water heating, electric heating, and boiler systems. The EP variant is configured for electric heating appliances, with 16A current loading and a weekly program. Main functions include WiFi app control for Android and Apple iOS, a full-screen touchscreen display, power-off memory, real-time data save, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program scheduling, anti-freezing protection, three sensor modes, and child lock.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS

tgm50-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tgm50-wifi-wp.description: Wi-Fi touchscreen room thermostat from the TGM50 series, suitable for water heating, electric heating, and boiler systems. The WP variant is configured for water heating appliances, with 3A current loading and a weekly program. Main functions include WiFi app control for Android and Apple iOS, a full-screen touchscreen display, power-off memory, real-time data save, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program scheduling, anti-freezing protection, three sensor modes, and child lock.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS
technicalData: current load: <=3A for water heating/gas boiler

tgm50b-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tgm50b-wifi-ep.description: Wi-Fi touchscreen room thermostat from the TGM50B series, suitable for water heating, electric heating, and boiler systems. The EP variant is configured for electric floor heating, with AC100-240V supply, 16A load current, and both an internal air sensor and an external floor sensor. It connects via the Tuya/Smart Life app, with Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Yandex Alice voice control on the WiFi version, and supports daily programming.
keyFeatures: GoogleHome / Amazon Alexa / Yandex Alice voice control for WiFi version
technicalData: load current: 16A for electric heating version

tgm50b-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tgm50b-wifi-wp.description: Wi-Fi water floor heating thermostat from the TGM50B series. It is configured for water floor control, with AC100-240V supply, 3A load current, and an internal air sensor only (wired connection). It supports daily programming, Tuya/Smart Life app control, and Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Yandex Alice voice control on the WiFi version.
keyFeatures: voice control via GoogleHome / Amazon Alexa / Yandex Alice for WiFi version

tcc31-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-ep.description: Wi-Fi smart knob thermostat from the TCC31 series. The EP variant is suitable for electric floor heating, rated IP20, with an NTC3950 10KΩ sensor, ±1°C accuracy, a 5-95°C set temperature range, and 100-240VAC power supply. It supports manual/automatic mode switching, knob-based temperature adjustment, advanced settings, child lock, and WiFi connectivity.
keyFeatures: EP suitable for electric floor heating
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

tcc31-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-wp.description: Wi-Fi smart knob thermostat from the TCC31 series. The WP variant is suitable for water heating. It supports manual/automatic mode switching, knob-based temperature adjustment, advanced settings, child lock, and WiFi connectivity.
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

tgr85-wifi-wpb.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
tgr85-wifi-wpb.description: Wi-Fi room thermostat from the TGR85 series, suitable for water heating, electric heating, and boiler systems. The WPB variant is configured for boilers connected via dry contact, with 3A current loading and a weekly program. Main functions include WiFi app control for Android and Apple iOS, a large-screen display with touch buttons, power-off memory, real-time data save, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program scheduling, anti-freezing protection, three sensor modes, and child lock.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS
large screen display and touch button
for boilers connected via dry contact.
technicalData: current load: <=3A for water heating/gas boiler, <=16A for electric heating

tgr85-wifi-ep.name: Electric Floor Heating Thermostat
tgr85-wifi-ep.description: TGR85-WIFI-EP is the electric floor-heating variant in the TGR85 series. It supports WiFi app control, a weekly programmable schedule, anti-freeze protection, child lock, and power-off memory with real-time data retention.
keyFeatures: WiFi control for Android and iOS

tcc31-wifi-wpb.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-wpb.description: Wi-Fi smart knob thermostat from the TCC31 series. The WPB variant is suitable for gas boiler heating. It supports manual/automatic mode switching, knob-based temperature adjustment, advanced settings, child lock, and WiFi connectivity.
keyFeatures: WPB suitable for gas boiler heating
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

bot-r7w-x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7w-x-wifi.description: Wireless gas boiler heating thermostat from the BOT-R7X family. It is an intelligent digital temperature controller that compares ambient temperature with the set temperature and controls the electric valve of a floor heating system to regulate room temperature, improving comfort and saving energy. The WiFi version adds app connectivity, with an NTC sensor, ±0.5°C precision, <170µW self-consumption, 3x1.5V battery power, 3A load current, and IP20 protection.
technicalData: K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces
normally open/normally close motorized valve notes.

bot-r7b-x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7b-x-wifi.description: Wireless gas boiler heating thermostat from the BOT-R7X family. It is an intelligent digital temperature controller that compares ambient temperature with the set temperature and controls the electric valve of a floor heating system to regulate room temperature, improving comfort and saving energy. The WiFi version adds app connectivity, with an NTC sensor, ±0.5°C precision, <170µW self-consumption, 3x1.5V battery power, 3A load current, and IP20 protection.
technicalData: K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces
normally open/normally close motorized valve notes.

bot-r8x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r8x-wifi.description: Wireless, one-to-one digital thermostat from the BOT-R8X family, designed for underfloor heating systems. It compares ambient temperature with the set temperature to control the working status of a gas wall-mounted boiler and electric valve, regulating room temperature for comfort and energy conservation. It connects via the Tuya Smart/Smart Life app over 2.4GHz WiFi.
keyFeatures: Tuya Smart / Smart Life network connection on 2.4 GHz WiFi
technicalData: Equipment power supply: 3x1.5V alkaline AAA batteries
WiFi setup via Tuya Smart/Smart Life and 2.4GHz WiFi.

trv-604.name: Thermostatic Radiator Valve
trv-604.description: Wi-Fi smart thermostatic radiator valve. It features an automatic debugging function compatible with mainstream valve types, fast Wi-Fi network pairing with no additional gateway required, an intelligent PID algorithm for efficient valve opening and closing, an ultra-quiet motor, and automatic summer/winter time conversion. It supports remote control and voice control through the Smart Life app.
keyFeatures: four time periods and setting temperature per day in Auto mode
Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant support
technicalData: Power supply: 3 x 1.5V alkaline AA batteries

trv-705wf.name: Thermostatic Radiator Valve
trv-705wf.description: LED Wi-Fi smart thermostatic radiator valve. It supports 4 standard modes and up to 6 programs per day across 7 days a week, and complies with CE (RED/LVD/EMC) and RoHS requirements. It connects directly to the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app without a Zigbee gateway, and temperature and working mode can be set on the device or via smartphone.
keyFeatures: LED WiFi smart thermostat radiator valve

cct-28-x.name: Hub Controller
cct-28-x.description: Wireless hub controller used in water underfloor heating systems. As a central control unit, it manages zone valves or boiler thermostats, together with the boiler and circulating pump. Based on the user's set temperature, it opens or closes the boiler, circulating pump, and electric actuators to achieve comfort and energy savings.
keyFeatures: central control for boiler, circulating pump, electric actuators and thermostats
time delay function for boiler/pump protection
technicalData: current loading: max 20mA in manual, 10A on product page
pump output delay: 5 min in manual

bot-r7x-wifi-nr.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7x-wifi-nr.description: Standalone Wi-Fi hydronic (water) underfloor heating thermostat from the BOT-R7X family, supplied with no receiver. It is an intelligent digital temperature controller that compares the current room temperature with the setpoint and controls the water valves of the underfloor heating system through its built-in relay, suitable for manifolds with electro-thermal actuators. It is compatible with the CCT-28-X hub controller for integration into centralized heating management systems, and the WiFi version supports remote control via a mobile app.
keyFeatures: mode switching between manual and automatic modes
IP20. The invoice additionally specifies no receiver and compatibility with CCT-28-X hub controller.
technicalData: WiFi connection steps through Tuya app
K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces in R7X source.

rz-d01-230-nc.name: Thermal Actuator
rz-d01-230-nc.description: Normally closed electro-thermal actuator valve for water floor heating systems. It integrates manual and automatic control functions and is used to control manifolds, water valves, and similar underfloor heating components.
keyFeatures: used to control manifolds and water valves.
